recipes.name: Easy Homemade Gravlox + Optional Cold Smoke Method
ingredients: 1.5 lbs (682g) center cut salmon fillet, skin on
Optional: dried bay leaves, cracked black pepper, 3% gin
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the salt and sugar.

Over a large baking sheet, place one long piece of plastic wrap across the pan from left to right, with a 3-inch overhang on both sides. Place another long piece of plastic wrap across the pan from top to bottom, with a 3-inch overhang on both sides.
In the center of the tray, use half of the cure to create a bed that matches the size of the salmon. If using aromatics, sprinkle on top.
Place the salmon over the cure, skin side down. If using, drizzle a small amount of gin over the salmon.
Sprinkle the remaining cure over the salmon, covering the entire surface and sides of the fish.

Cover the top of the salmon with dill. Bring up the sides of the plastic wrap and tightly enclose the fish. Place the wrapped salmon, seam side down, in a rimmed baking dish. Place a similar, but smaller baking dish on top of the fish. Place a heavy weight (canned tomatoes, for example) into the dish to press the salmon down.
Place in the fridge and allow to cure for 1-3 days. The thickest part of the fillet should feel firm to the touch.
Remove the cure from the fish, rinse well under cold running water and pat dry.
Using a long knife positioned at a 45-degree angle, cut thin slices.
